title: Empowering Bayes with sources of uncertainty: from confidence modelling to sparse estimation
abstract: arXiv:2605.03134v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce sources of uncertainty (SoU) inference, a general framework that extends Bayesian inference by allowing researchers to explicitly encode heterogeneous confidence across model components. This heterogeneity allows the probabilistic treatment to vary selectively across the model, controlling both the uncertainty retained within each component and its propagation to the rest of the model. Empirical Bayes and profiling-type inference emerge as limiting configurations of this selective treatment. Because confidence acts through a mechanism distinct from prior informativeness, the two can be controlled separately, providing an additional degree of freedom for Bayesian model design. Building on this selective treatment, we develop a general approach for inducing sparsity in statistical models and illustrate its use in linear and logistic regression, as well as in Bayesian neural networks, where it enables self-pruning.

translated_title: 用不确定性来源赋能贝叶斯推断：从置信度建模到稀疏估计
translated_abstract: 我们提出了不确定性来源推断，这是一个通用框架，通过允许研究者显式编码模型各组件间异质的置信度来扩展贝叶斯推断。这种异质性使概率处理能够在模型的不同部分选择性地变化，同时控制每个组件内部保留的不确定性及其向模型其余部分的传播。经验贝叶斯和轮廓型推断可作为这种选择性处理的极限情形而自然出现。由于置信度通过与先验信息量不同的机制发挥作用，两者可以分别控制，这为贝叶斯模型设计提供了额外的自由度。基于这种选择性处理，我们开发了一种在统计模型中诱导稀疏性的通用方法，并在线性回归、逻辑回归以及贝叶斯神经网络中展示了其应用，在贝叶斯神经网络中它能够实现自剪枝。
tldr: 该论文提出不确定性来源（SoU）推断框架，通过在模型组件间显式编码异质置信度来扩展贝叶斯推断，使置信度与先验信息量可分别控制，并据此开发了诱导稀疏性的通用方法，可应用于线性/逻辑回归及贝叶斯神经网络的自剪枝。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces sources of uncertainty (SoU) inference, a general framework extending Bayesian inference by explicitly encoding heterogeneous confidence across model components, enabling confidence and prior informativeness to be controlled separately, and providing a general approach for inducing sparsity, including self-pruning in Bayesian neural networks.
